name: Mario Kart DS

project.name: mkds-android
project.license: MIT (decompilation RonyxDumb/mkds); the Android repo has no license file

assets.needs: Your own Mario Kart DS ROM, Europe only (game code AMCP).
assets.location: Picked with the system file picker at first start and copied once to /data/data/com.mkds.port/files/rom.nds (root-only). The ROM header must carry game code AMCP.
assets.notes: Tested: after import the game boots to the title screen.

settings.in_app_menu: None. The Java side has no settings screen; language follows the device locale (Native.setLanguage).
settings.summary: No settings file. The app picks the display's highest refresh-rate mode itself.

controls: Gamepads via Android InputDevice (hot-plug aware); an on-screen touch overlay (ControlsView) during races when no gamepad is connected.
display: Both DS screens are laid out on one surface on the display the app opens on (Native.setLayout/setWideAspect). No second-display code. Not checked on the Thor.
saves: /data/data/com.mkds.port/files/mkds.sav (root-only; back up with root). crash.txt and log.txt sit beside it.
notes: Upstream's v0.23 build reports versionName 0.1 (signer f2be4574..., the v0.23 key in Recompa's index). v0.28 and v0.50 (2026-11-24) are signed with different keys, so updating from an older build means uninstalling first, which deletes mkds.sav (back it up with root). Supports local Wi-Fi multiplayer (multicast lock).
verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs, ROM header bytes. APK: jadx of MainActivity/Native; native strings. Web: GitHub API releases, Recompa index (package and signer history). Not checked: in-game display layout and controls.
